newsitem.title: NORWAY: SOCCER-TWO-LEG FORMAT ABANDONED FOR UEFA CUP FINAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TWO-LEG FORMAT ABANDONED FOR UEFA CUP FINAL.

text.p: Next season's UEFA Cup is final will be played as a one-off fixture instead of the two-leg format of recent years, UEFA president Lennart Johannson announced on Friday.

Johannson, speaking to reporters after a regular meeting of the UEFA executive committee in Oslo, confirmed the UEFA Cup final would still be held in May, preceding the Cup Winners Cup and European Cup finals.
